result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a marked continental crosswalk with a curb ramp. However, the street lacks traffic calming measures and a buffer between the walkway and the travel lane, while parked vehicles create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Truck
hazards.description: A large white truck parked on the right side of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, mid-ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or planting strip.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow concrete sidewalk directly adjacent to a commercial building housing a childcare center. While the walkway is clear of physical obstructions, the lack of a buffer from the adjacent parallel parking and travel lane creates a high-risk environment for children and caregivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians, which is particularly dangerous given the presence of a childcare facility.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground along the curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk has no horizontal separation or buffer from the parking and travel lanes, increasing the risk of conflict.

interventions.title: School/Daycare Zone Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility signage and pavement markings to alert drivers to the presence of children and encourage lower speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersection to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances for families.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install mid-block speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in front of the childcare center.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks and buildings directly fronting the walkway, creating an active urban environment. However, the lack of marked pedestrian crossings and traffic calming measures, combined with sightline obstructions from parked cars, increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates a visual barrier between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Lack of marked pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible in the immediate area, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian crossing behavior and reduced driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve the visibility of pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this mixed-use environment.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban midblock environment with multi-story residential or mixed-use buildings fronting directly onto the sidewalk. While a marked midblock crossing is present, the markings are significantly faded and lack supporting infrastructure like curb extensions or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking right up to the crossing point limits sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the midblock crossing.
